slug: 2026-07-15 CSquared boosts internet by integrating with 2Africa West cable

facts.fact: Mobile Europe reports CSquared, a wholesale operator, added capacity on the 2Africa West system, described as an open-access system; the article places Abidjan among 2Africa/West African landing-station cities.

note: Outages (Mar 2024 landslide, two June 2026 Abidjan-area cuts) are temporary, not none. Equiano lands in Nigeria/Togo, not CIV.
